subject: Re: User-specified SEM will not converge

messages.subject: Re: User-specified SEM will not converge
parts:
Thanks for reaching out and glad you are using the package! A model can be identified but still not converge on a solution. For your particular model you have a number of constraints in your model that may cause convergence issues, such as fixing the factor correlations to 0 and having to fix the factor loadings for factor 2 to equality. I understand that you are doing some of these things for the express purpose of making sure your model is (locally) identified, but at the same time these are just the sort of constraints that can also cause convergence issues. Ways to troubleshoot would be to consider adding in additional variables, trying alternative models, and trying different start values for the model you ran. 

Best, 
  Andrew
